item.title: BOYS BASKETBALL ROUNDUP: Lathrop tops Colfax for Rocklin tourney crown
item.description: Lathrop’s boys basketball team picked up its biggest win of the season on Saturday, capturing the Dan Taylor Tip-Off Tournament championship with a 74-63 victory against previously-undefeated Colfax at Rocklin.

item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL ROUNDUP: Lancers roll past Gregori in OT to 4-peat as Golden Valley tourney champs
item.description: A nip-and-tuck battle for four quarters on Saturday turned into an overtime rout in the championship round of the 30th annual Golden Valley Lady Cougar Classic in Merced. East Union held Gregori to a single point in the extra period, earning its fourth straight title in the tournament with the 56-44 victory.

item.title: ROUNDUP: Ripon girls basketball routs Tokay
item.description: Ripon’s girls basketball team took care of winless Tokay 48-26 on the road Monday, getting 10 points each from Scarlett Ponce and Savannah Richardson. A 15-4 second quarter broke it open for the Indians (4-3), as they held Tokay to single-digit scoring in three quarters.

item.title: What’s stranger than fiction? That’s easy, California water politics & greater Manteca area water issues.
item.description: If Jed Clampett was shooting at some food back in 1991 on Stewart Tract and not in the Missouri Ozarks and hit the ground instead, what would have come bubbling up wouldn’t have been oil.

item.title: Raw water cost to Manteca may rise 334 percent
item.description: Manteca — as well as the cities of Tracy and Lathrop — are now paying 2005 prices for raw surface water. That is about to change.

item.title: Manteca Police walk tightrope in managing homeless situations
item.description: You’re walking down a sidewalk or bicycling along the Tidewater Bikeway when you are accosted by someone who is clearly homeless.

item.title: Ripon Community Center parking lot being expanded
item.description: Plans are in the works to expand the existing parking lot at the Ripon Community Center.

item.title: Ripon Christian FFA team national floriculture champs
item.description: The Ripon Christian High Future Farmers of America Floriculture team captured the National Finals Career Development Event in Indianapolis.

item.title: CHRISTMAS GIVING TREE
item.description: Paul Gross is the administrator at Guardian Care & Rehabilitation Center. Formerly known as Manteca Care & Rehabilitation Center, the skilled nursing and immediate care facility at 410 Eastwood Ave. helps residents in their healing and recovery. But, according to Gross, the holidays can be tough on them. Enter Precision Auto.

item.title: 20 OR SO MORE FEET MAY MEAN BIG PAY DAY FOR MANTECA NEEDS
item.description: Modifying the city’s height limit for signs along freeway corridors could translate into hundreds of thousands of dollars in general fund revenue to help underwrite municipal services.
